notes.title: Firestone Full Release 1st of April
notes.notes:
Dear Firestone Community,

We're thrilled to celebrate Firestone's [b]5th anniversary[/b] this April! It feels as if our journey began just yesterday, yet it has been an eventful period for us at Holyday Studios. We're dedicated to continuously enhancing the game and making it even more enjoyable for our fantastic community.

We're also pleased to announce that Firestone is officially moving out of early access on Steam into [b]full release[/b]! Looking ahead, we're excited about the ongoing development, new features, and the opportunity to welcome many more friends and community members in the coming years.

[h3]New Expansion "The Oracle"[/h3]
It wouldn’t be a great global launch without adding [b]new features[/b] however! For this reason we have prepared an exciting expansion to the game by introducing [b]“The Oracle”[/b]. A brand new mechanism accessible from the town. The expansion will go [b]live at the 1st of April.[/b]


[h3]Anniversary Event[/h3]
To mark these significant milestones, we're delighted to unveil our Anniversary Event, available to all players of level 10 and above from the 2nd to the 30th of April.
Here's an important detail about the event's timing: it lasts for 2 weeks, starting from when you log in and meet the level requirement during this period. If you log in as a level 10+ player on April 1st, the event starts the next day at 10am (your local time) for you and concludes 14 days later. If you're new to the game and reach level 10 on April 19th, your event kicks off from the next day at 10am and runs for the following 14 days. This approach ensures everyone gets the full 2-week event experience, tailored to their start date within April.

During this special event, all qualifying players can acquire a variety of in-game currencies, gifts, 4 limited-time avatars, and – for the first time in the history of Firestone – [b]2 alternative skins[/b] for your favorite heroes Boris and Solaine.

Join us to play, battle, chat, and immerse yourself in the celebratory spirit as we open a new chapter in Firestone's history. We're profoundly grateful for your continued support and love as we embark on this next phase of our journey.

Warmest regards for 5 years and many more to come,
The team at Holyday Studios.

notes.title: Firestone Idle RPG - Multiplayer & Art Redesign Major Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
We are happy to announce that Firestone Idle RPG just achieved [b]2 major updates[/b].

[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]
You can now play and create your own [b]Guild[/b], co-operate with your friends from other platforms and achieve great boosts. 
You can all now communicate in your own [b]private guild chats[/b], create guild strategies and help your guild 
compete on [b]cross-platform leaderboards[/b].
A whole [b]new town[/b] has been added to the game to host all the mechanisms related to the guilds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35813526/9423f37887a89fc873d263a07c3ac1ab10095d6f.png[/img]

[h1]Major art redesign[/h1]
Along with the guilds we redesigned the game from scratch. The new style is [b]more fun and less realistic[/b]. 
We believe that you are all here to have fun and forget real life and realism for a while! We also added a new gaming cursor that was proposed by the community a long time ago. Last but not least, we added [b]new avatars[/b] for your character!

New: You can set your personal description in any of the languages that are supported by the game. When someone is inspecting you he can see this description. Change that from the character menu. Please be polite!
New: World Map Zoom using slider. You can change the zoom either with the mouse wheel or using the new slider located at the bottom right part of the world map screen.
